top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, independently reproduced quantum-control invention: magic-wavelength trapping enables controlled many-atom interrogation while suppressing the differential trapping shift. The Katori–Ye concept-to-defining-realization allocation is compact and presently more bounded than the alternatives, provided the citation remains limited to the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks.
recusal_note: No apparent personal, institutional, or collaborative connection to Hidetoshi Katori or Jun Ye is identified in the supplied profile.
